name: io.github.ab2dridi/akko-mcp-trino
title: AKKO MCP server for Trino
description: Read-only MCP server for Trino: queries run as the verified user, and Trino's own policies decide.

environmentVariables.name: TRINO_HTTP_SCHEME
environmentVariables.description: https (required by the default identity mode)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_JWKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint of the OIDC provider

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OIDC_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: The audience of tokens issued for this server (never Trino's)

environmentVariables.name: TRINO_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint for OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (jwt mode)

environmentVariables.name: TRINO_TOKEN_EXCHANGE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: This server's client at the provider (jwt mode)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The user's bearer token, issued for this server (stdio transport)
